revised_comments: Lesotho has no centralised government portal enabling public-facing digital ID authentication. The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation (MICSTI) is building the underlying digital public infrastructure — X-Road for secure inter-agency data exchange and a MOSIP-based national digital identity platform — with the National University of Lesotho and UNICEF under the 2026 Annual Work Plan. Authentication currently occurs only via agency-to-agency APIs rather than a public government portal; mobile-based and cross-service authentication is targeted as the MOSIP rollout progresses.

Definition: Whether a Data Protection Authority or similar body regulates ID data collection and sharing by the ID system
Comments: Although the Data Protection Act 2011 provides for a Data Protection Commission, this body has never been established. As of 2025, Lesotho's government acknowledges the Commission remains unestablished and calls for its establishment as a priority. Regulatory functions remain unperformed.

revised_comments: No Data Protection Authority oversees ID data collection and sharing in Lesotho. The Data Protection Act mandates the creation of an independent Data Protection Commission, but this body has never been appointed or operationalised, leaving the Act's provisions on complaint-handling, compliance audits and enforcement unimplemented in practice. Government officials and civil society continue to call for the Commission's establishment as a priority, alongside proposed reforms to align the Act with the AU Malabo Convention and other regional and international data protection standards.
